acceptance: Profile worker treats duplicate intent UUID retries as gateway-owned replay, not new decisions.
Profile docs forbid time-based resubmission or hidden deterministic gates.
SOUL and AUTHORITY describe truthful evidence-only cognition aligned with gateway receipts.

items.title: Align ARCHITECTURE with flat frame warmup gate

Either document GLITCH_TOPSTEP_DECISION_FRAME_COUNT as scheduling warmup, or remove silent flat gate and invoke with available frames.
evidence: 2026-07-30 decision: keep flat warmup at GLITCH_TOPSTEP_DECISION_FRAME_COUNT (default 5).
